experiment: long-context curve - history and slot recall vs context length
conclusions: short context (<=616 tokens): zero interference, history flat at 12/12 for 0..8 slots
long context (>=1K tokens): with slots history is 1-2 questions lower than the no-slot control (92->75, 83->67)
slot retrieval degrades faster than history: 100% at 192 tokens, 17-50% at 1.1K-4.2K tokens
limitations: n=2 trials, 12 questions per cell - the 1-2 question gap is within noise, direction consistent but magnitude unreliable
needs n>=8 to claim long-context interference
